description: A Flutter widget `AvatarSquare` that displays a rounded square avatar placeholder. It supports optional image, child widget, customizable size, border radius, and background color. If an image is provided, it displays the image with rounded corners; otherwise, it shows an icon with a styled background.

classes.name: AvatarSquare
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a rounded square avatar placeholder with optional image or child widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the avatar, showing either an image with rounded corners or a styled container with an icon.
